title: Melody Makers
locationName: Aurora Town Square – Program Room A, 50 Victoria Street, Aurora, Ontario, Canada
address: Aurora Town Square – Program Room A, 50 Victoria Street, Aurora, Ontario, Canada
description: Register Here Starting August 11! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. September 27 – November 22, 2025 [SKIP October 11] Saturdays | 12:15 – 1:15 pm| Ages 6-8 Aurora Town Square – Program Room A 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Melody Makers is designed for children ages 6-8 years old and parents are asked to wait outside of the classroom. No previous music experience is required. Learn to play music both individually and as an ensemble using pitched instruments focusing on developing fundamental music skills such as keeping a steady beat, playing a melody, creating harmony and reading music notation. We will explore pitched instruments such as keyboards, boom whackers, and bells as well as some other percussive instruments. This is a great way to expose your children to music before transitioning into private lessons. Come join us and discover the joy and benefits of music! Materials Fee of $17 to be paid to instructor at first class.
